# thalassa_iam_federated_identity (Data Source)

Get a federated identity by identity or name



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identity of the federated identity
- `name` (String) Name of the federated identity
- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation of the federated identity. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_scopes` (List of String) Scopes the federated identity is allowed to access
- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations for the federated identity
- `audience_match_mode` (String) How audience matching is performed
- `conditions` (String) Conditions/claims matcher rules as JSON
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339)
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the federated identity
- `expires_at` (String) Expiration timestamp (RFC3339)
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels for the federated identity
- `last_used_at` (String) Last used timestamp (RFC3339)
- `object_version` (Number) Object version of the federated identity
- `provider_id` (String) Identity of the federated identity provider
- `provider_subject` (String) Subject identifier from the OIDC provider
- `service_account_id` (String) Identity of the bound service account
- `status` (String) Status of the federated identity
- `trusted_audiences` (List of String) List of trusted audiences
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339)
